objective: Align native Cluster and Organization room view to canonical Connect header without stacked dashboard chrome; render the true weekday/time of each message with compact bubbles and closer seen-reader avatars.
productionBaselineEvidence: 2026-11-20 checked GitHub main 536741f8d97fc9dec91503c89f1c1160e5987ce0 and Genesis consolidated staging intake 2abd7ecdfd2e7606c7bee07fe3984f451f841d07; source ancestry is not device or live OTA proof.
chosenApproach: Reuse canonical BuklodConnectThread and ConnectThreadHeader, hide native scope dashboard chrome only while its Connect section is active, preserve desktop shell, show per-message sent-at as tiny weekday/time inside each bubble, keep full timestamp on tap and reduce spacing on seen avatars.
selectionRationale: Single shared Connect implementation preserves scope authorization, room read cursors, send order, media, calls, reactions and message actions without parallel state or another thread screen.
alternativeApproaches: Create separate Cluster chat renderer: rejected because it would duplicate send/read state and regress features.
Force redirect to personal messages: rejected because it changes room scope and back navigation.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Change only chat viewport, compact spacing and message time display using existing native/React Native modules.
preservedBehaviors: No native dependency, JS runtime, payload, consent, AdMob placement or navigation provider modification.
Existing optimistic send, media, GIF, offline retry, messages ordering and scroll anchor are unchanged.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Reuse the canonical Connect room header and local message sent timestamp without touching verified reader/call state.
preservedBehaviors: Room-read cursors are not per-message delivery proofs, and unchanged server metadata remains the authority.
Direct call, scope Office/PTT launcher, reactions, attachments and long-press actions remain mounted.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Render the existing scope Connect conversation as full-screen native chat and preserve Home/Community and desktop layout.
preservedBehaviors: Full scope id and membership guard stay unchanged; back returns to the same workspace Home.
No changes to Cluster/Organization membership, prayers, community feeds, permissions or posting.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: The protected-feature classifier treats the 'ad' substring in BuklodConnectThread as ad-sensitive; this visual-only fix must demonstrate AdMob and economy isolation.
preservedBehaviors: No changes to AdMob ad placement IDs, consent/prefetch/lifecycle, first-view fill, ad impression or earnings state.
No changes to QMP, payouts, reward logic, Cluster finance, referral points, or other user economy state.

preserveBehaviors: No modifications to database/RLS, backend read-cursor RPCs, media signing, push, and referral/points economy.
No changes to application identification, native runtime, EAS channels or OTA publisher.
Keep app-wide ad rendering and dashboard switching release blockers.
acceptanceChecks: Source readback and protected feature lock pass, both focused Node tests pass.
TypeScript and existing relevant chat regression checks pass.
Chat and ad isolation source-contract tests pass, with real ad/nav regression gates still required before release.
Native on-device verify scoped fullscreen header, message timestamps, message/seen avatar density, input/keyboard.
Verify ad-first-view and dashboard navigation before any Genesis staging OTA release.
releaseTarget: Next separately source-pinned Genesis staging RC; production untouched
